name: Greater Alpine Tribunal
description: The Hermetic tribunal of the Alps, noted for centuries of Hermetic peace, strict enforcement of the Code, Roman-inspired culture and a ban on new covenants.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal strongly supported by the Greater Alps since its inception to counter House Tremere's expansion; it adopted the Alpine rule forbidding new covenants.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: A desperately vis-poor tribunal to the south that receives surplus Intellego, Auram, Terram and Vim vis from the Alps.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Neighbouring region whose incursions into the Alps are taken seriously by autumn Alpine covenants.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order-wide tribunal to which cases may be appealed; Alpine delegates have tried to pass local customs through it.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House whose Alpine members are conservative and see themselves as Roman nobility; they designed the ostracism system and celebrate Boot Burning.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House centered on the Cave of Twisting Shadows, devoted to seeking the Enigma and ascension into Twilight.

name: House Guernicus
description: House whose senior representatives, along with Mercere's, receive a pawn of vis per year from each Alpine covenant.

name: House Mercere
description: The House of redcaps; its members wear the red cap (pellus) and hold inheritable magic items called Whitlams.

name: House Tremere
description: House toward which the Alps harbour ancient ill will dating from the Sundering; it dominated the Greater Alps in the ninth century.

name: House Flambeau
description: Militant House whose magi customarily wear red, like dedicated hoplites' red cloaks.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House; Regina was originally trained as a follower of Bonisagus, and a Bonisagus claimed Siobhan's latest apprentice.

name: House Verditius
description: House of magical crafters, referred to as the Verdi; some of its magi are brewers.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-oriented House; Siobhan retrained under a Merinita magus to learn Faerie Magic, and some Merinita brew alcohol.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House whose magi have an affinity for Rauhnachte and withdraw from society on that day; its cone symbol resembles the Mercere triangle.

name: Cave of Twisting Shadows
aliases: Covenant of the Cave of Twisting Shadows
description: Domus magna of House Criamon: a series of looping tunnels duplicated through nine regio levels around a natural cave that emerges into the realm of Magic.

name: Covenant of the Icy North
description: Alpine covenant whose Motherhouse hosts the Midsummer Fair and whose chapters include Rorschach, Juno's Spire and the Tower of Ashes; it has a famed library.

name: Covenant Where Journeys End
description: Alpine covenant whose council knows that disorder begins with pillaging faerie courts for vis; its grogs' training is secretive.

name: Covenant of the Sinews of Knowledge
description: Alpine covenant for which peaceful trade is its lifeblood; linked with the service of age-related magic.

name: Covenant of Tarragon Vale
description: Alpine covenant that traditionally hosted the Liberalia; its members vanished over a decade ago and heirs contest its resources.

name: Covenant of Valnastium
description: Alpine covenant practicing an almost democratic style, sponsor of the Liberalia since Tarragon Vale's members vanished; site of Jerbiton's villa.

name: Highest Aspiration
description: Covenant of Leodontina's filii, looted during the Hunt that followed her ostracism in the Sundering.

name: Tower of Ashes
description: Chapter of the Covenant of the Icy North led by Archmaga Jacinta, run on the self-sufficient manorial model.

name: Spire of Juno
description: Chapter of the Covenant of the Icy North, home of Archmage Pietro.

name: Rorschach Chapter
description: Chapter of the Icy North where Alpine redcaps are trained; its Mercere act as purchasing and shipping agents and carry declarations of war.

name: Motherhouse of the Covenant of the Icy North
description: Main site of the Covenant of the Icy North where the Midsummer Fair is held.

name: Jacinta filia Romana
description: Archmaga of the Tower of Ashes who writes to her apprentice Ash about the economics of Alpine peace.

name: Noire
description: Maga, formerly Ash, apprentice of Jacinta filia Romana.

name: Yselt
description: Alpine magus who intensely dislikes Andru but cannot afford a war.

name: Andru
description: Alpine magus who intensely dislikes Yselt.

name: Archmage Pietro
description: Archmage of the Spire of Juno chapter of the Icy North and current lictor of the Greater Alpine Tribunal.

name: Anastasia
description: Filia of Archmage Pietro, returning to join the Covenant of the Icy North.

name: Leodontina
description: Filia of Tremere who became unhinged before Tribunal and was ostracized; most of her filii were killed in the ensuing Hunt.

name: Tremere
description: Founder of House Tremere; parens of Leodontina.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere who changed the House's symbol to the pellus after his final transformation.

name: Whitlam
description: Magus two generations descended from Mercere who first enunciated the doctrine that magic items should be inheritable; Whitlam items are named after him.

name: Esperance
description: Follower of Verditius whose diary describes the history of Whitlams.

name: Mary
description: Wizard of Mercere who briefs the newly Gauntleted redcap Gunther on Alpine survival.

name: Gunther (redcap)
description: Newly Gauntleted redcap briefed by Mary on his warming pin and survival in the Alps.

name: Cymena
description: An example of a Mythic Redcap in the book.

name: Jerbiton
description: Founder of House Jerbiton, who rejoined his mortal family and burned his shoes at Valnastium; wrote a celebrated poem on his wedding anniversary.

name: Miriam
description: Jerbiton's wife, a puzzling figure of early Order history; Bonisagus loved her honey cakes.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder who loved Miriam's honey cakes.

name: Criamon
description: Founder of House Criamon, who appointed Hera and bound her ghost to the Cave to serve his followers.

name: La
description: Prima of House Criamon and Praeco, an elderly Rego specialist once called Lucia who murdered a priest under the Black Mark and is cursed by God.

name: Circum Perfico
description: Elderly Criamon maga who believes a Hermes Portal between the Cave and the North Pole would align the Earth's axis with its magical fields.

name: Darius filius Yannes
description: Criamon Muto Mentem specialist and brewer of mind-altering alcohols, popular with grogs but disliked by the Quaesitores.

name: Echo filia Gribbinus
description: Criamon Mentem specialist with an affinity for ghosts, secretly in love with a Criamon ghost three centuries dead.

name: Esther filia Gribbinus
description: Criamon Imaginem specialist petrified by faeries whose ghost-like form may be a juno created by Twilight.

name: Fortuito filius Circum Perfico
description: Criamon Seeker who studies diviners and sends predictive letters to be delivered only after disasters.

name: Gunther filius Frederico
description: Criamon chief baker of the Cave who seeks wisdom in the perfection of mundane life.

name: Hagen filius Flauberto the Difficult
description: Criamon who creates atonal music with summoned spirits; his lineage is prone to madness from studying Plato's Comma.

name: Latrunculus filius Aurelia
description: Criamon Terram magus and surveyor who believes the Great Ones are buried at Roman road intersections.

name: Muscaria filia Darius
description: Practical Criamon maga who developed the Cave's mushroom farms; her predecessors expect her to become the next Prima.

name: Pellam filius Cato
description: Young Criamon who believes ball sports are remnants of pagan rituals leading toward the Enigma.

name: Phalene filia Innocu
description: Criamon who studies metamorphic animals and sees Twilight as a biological process.

name: Regina filia Gribbinus
description: Magus trained as a follower of Bonisagus (by Dexter) who shifted to the Criamon; creates mystical spaces.

name: Siobhan filia Vespasian the Avaricious
description: Hibernian Criamon Vim specialist and the House's expert on faeries, who learned Faerie Magic from a Merinita.

name: Viscus filius Circum Perfico
description: Criamon who seeks the Enigma through haruspicy on the entrails of magical animals; least popular magus among the redcaps.

name: Hera
description: Ghostly autocrat and chatelaine of the Cave of Twisting Shadows, appointed by Criamon in life and bound to serve his followers.

name: Giselbertine
description: Parens of Prima La.

name: Johannes
description: Parens of Circum Perfico.

name: Yannes
description: Parens of Darius.

name: Gribbinus
description: Criamon parens of Echo, Esther and Regina.

name: Frederico
description: Parens of Gunther of the Cave.

name: Flauberto the Difficult
description: Parens of Hagen.

name: Aurelia
description: Parens of Latrunculus.

name: Cato
description: Parens of Pellam.

name: Innocu
description: Parens of Phalene.

name: Dexter
description: Follower of Bonisagus who co-trained Regina.

name: Vespasian the Avaricious
description: Parens of Siobhan.

name: Caesar
description: Roman figure who in a Jerbiton parable accidentally destroyed the library of Alexandria.

name: Pralix
description: Figure of the Pralix incident, which led to the brief existence of the Order of Miscellany.

name: Great Ones
description: Ancient beings Latrunculus believes are buried at major intersections of the Roman road network.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi whose peace the Alpine tribunal maintains.

name: Order of Mercury
description: Ancient Roman order of magicians at its height in the Imperial period; the pellus was worn between its fall and the founding of the Order of Hermes.

name: Order of Miscellany
description: Short-lived rival order resulting from the Pralix incident.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators and judges who register vis sources, count ostracism votes and direct hoplites.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of House Mercere, in the Alps trained at Rorschach and Basel, carrying Whitlams and declarations of war.

name: Hoplites
description: Volunteer magi who assist the Quaesitores with military force; dedicated hoplites serve seven-year stints and wear red cloaks.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: Mystery group existing within the hoplites, as the Cult of Mithras did within the Roman legions.

name: Cult of Mithras
description: Ancient cult within the Roman legions, the model for the Legion of Mithras.

name: Black Mark
description: Splinter Criamon society believing the Dominion will destroy all magic; possibly Infernally inspired. La murdered a priest under its precepts.

name: Cult of Dyssynergy
description: House Criamon's bugbear, believed to oppose humanity's acceleration into Twilight; may not exist.

name: Cult of Twilight
description: Mystery cult; if used, the Cave of Twisting Shadows is one of its centers.

name: Central Clutch
description: The core 15 resident magi of the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

name: Seekers
description: Magi seeking esoteric knowledge and ancient sites; Fortuito and Latrunculus are consulted by them.

name: Primi of Criamon
description: The ghosts of past Criamon primi who remain at the Cave, teach rarely and influence history through the living Primus.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Body of tribunal-specific legal rulings; the Alpine Peripheral Code records vis treaties, public vis sources and protected church sites.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Order's law, enforced in the Alps to a degree found nowhere else.

name: Buying a Chair
description: Alpine process by which a covenant pledges ten pawns of vis a year from a registered source to give a magus a vote at tribunal.

name: Vagrancy
description: Alpine low crime of a magus having no registered vis supply.

name: Chapter House
description: Geographically separate settlement of an Alpine covenant, bound to it in law, where magi dwell; without magi it is a 'property'.

name: Motherhouse
description: The political center of an Alpine covenant with chapters.

name: Ostracism
description: Seven-yearly secret ballot using sherds; the magus with most votes must leave the Greater Alps or be Marched.

name: Sherd
description: Small slate on which Alpine magi write the name of the magus they most despise in ostracism.

name: Hunting
description: Declaring Wizard's War on an ostracized magus before they can establish a new covenant.

name: Disorder
description: Alpine term for intercovenant warfare, technically legal but seen as deeply immoral.

name: Interference with the Church
description: Hermetic crime; certain church sites in the Alpine Peripheral Code treat even minor violence as interference.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal declared conflict between magi; in the Alps declarations peak in March and are carried by fetiales.

name: Wizard's March
description: Order sanction to hunt down an outlaw magus; coordinated in the Alps by the lictor.

name: Lictor
description: Experienced hoplite chosen by the Greater Alpine Tribunal to coordinate Wizards' Marches; wears a leopard-edged sash.

name: Indenture
description: Contract promising future service, notably by hoplites repaying longevity potions; also a free Virtue for mythic redcaps.

name: Praeco
description: Presiding office at Tribunal; in the Alps La holds it.

name: Dividing the Enemy
description: Alpine policy of rewarding one party for betraying its allies in a coalition against the Alps.

name: Fetiales
description: Redcaps from Rorschach traveling in threes to deliver declarations of Wizard's War, carrying salt, coal and the complaint.

name: Complaint
description: Letter declaring and justifying Wizard's War, often containing a clause of redress.

name: Tokens of War
description: Tokens dispatched when declaring war, when some aggressive magi don the pulla.

name: Days of Trembling
description: February, when Alpine apprentices are tested and archmages declare which challenger they will receive.

name: Liberalia
description: March Ceremony of Welcome for apprentices and its feasting, traditionally hosted by Tarragon Vale.

name: Ceremony of Welcome
description: Ceremony at which apprentices are sworn into the Order.

name: Frustration Week
description: Late April when many Wizard's Wars begin; magi exchange gifts and vis treaties are delivered.

name: May Day Eve
description: Night when magi retreat behind Aegises due to peasant purification festivals able to Hex magi.

name: Bean-Spitting Day
description: May custom derived from Roman ghost-warding; Valnastium holds a bean feast.

name: Midsummer Fair
description: Week-long annual fair at the Icy North Motherhouse, grown from the annual distribution of vis, where magi trade vis and goods.

name: Midsummer's Eve
description: Night when most Alpine chapters renew their Aegises and gather fern seeds.

name: Boot Burning
description: August 19th Jerbiton custom commemorating Jerbiton burning his shoes at Valnastium.

name: Baker's Day
description: September 5th, Jerbiton's wedding anniversary, after which Hermetic marriages take place.

name: Confarreation
description: Marriage by contract signed before ten witnesses; binding under Hermetic law if a quaesitor witnesses (dotal contract).

name: Coemption
description: Roman marriage form of mutual symbolic slavery, considered demeaning by magi.

name: Customary Marriage
description: Simplest marriage form, most practiced by covenfolk: a year of cohabitation.

name: Rauhnachte
description: Austrian festival in late October when some animals gain speech and powers; celebrated by familiars.

name: Quinquennial Games
description: Tribunal-wide games held every five years after a tribunal, culminating in a nude shielded race.

name: Decennials
description: Every second Quinquennial, open to turbs from surrounding tribunals.

name: Seculars
description: Games celebrated every tenth Decennial with extra pomp.

name: Childermas
description: December 28th, when ghosts of dead apprentices are said to haunt their masters.

name: Inverse Auction
description: Auction at the Midsummer Fair where bids start high and descend; bids taken in Vim vis.

name: Pawn
description: Basic unit of vis; ten pawns make a rook.

name: Rook
description: Vis unit of ten pawns; ten rooks make a queen.

name: Queen
description: Unit of account equal to ten rooks of vis.

name: Circle
description: Older Roman-based vis unit of four pawns, often infused in a ring or disc; used in Alpine contracts.

name: Chess System
description: Decimal vis currency (pawn, rook, queen) invented by the Tremere.

name: Vis
description: Magical resource measured in pawns, relatively abundant in the Alps.

name: Longevity Potion
description: Potion delaying aging; given to hoplites after long service and to redcaps at 35.

name: Twilight
description: Mystical state Criamon seek to ascend into; amaranth makes it more likely and dangerous.

name: Enigma
description: The mystical truth sought by House Criamon.

name: Regio
description: Layered magical area; the Cave of Twisting Shadows has nine levels.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural strength of a place; high auras are used for study at chapters.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Protective ritual renewed annually by covenants; Alpine chapters renew it on Midsummer's Eve.

name: Certamen
description: Magical duel; using vis in certamen is seen as spendthrift in the Alps.

name: Familiar
description: Magical animal bound to a magus; celebrated on Rauhnachte.

name: Gauntlet
description: Test ending apprenticeship.

name: Sigil
description: Token of a magus's vote; ostracized magi may give sigils they carry to another magus.

name: Axis Magica
description: The pivot of the world's magical tides, believed by Criamon to be the regio through the Cave.

name: Domus Magna
description: House headquarters; the Cave is Criamon's domus magna.

name: Primus
description: Head of a House; Criamon primi delay Twilight and are ritually slain by an outsider.

name: Slaying the Primus
description: Criamon ritual in which a magus of another House ritually murders the primus on the eighth regio level.

name: Hermes Portal
description: Magical gateway; Valnastium has a network of them.

name: Plato's Comma
description: A fundamental flaw in the seven notes corresponding to the seven planets; research into it drives Hagen's lineage mad.

name: Faerie Trods
description: Faerie paths that the Roman road network is believed to resemble.

name: Juno
description: Externalized conscience created from the spirit of a morally-conflicted being; Esther may be one.

name: Alpine Dragon
description: Mythic dragon so large it eats other dragons, said to lie beneath the Alps.

name: Ghost
description: Spirits of the dead; much of the Cave's population are ghosts that serve as its library.

name: Faerie
description: Beings of the Faerie realm, threats in the Alps, especially in winter.

name: Elementals
description: Dangerous beings active in the Alpine winter.

name: Amaranth
description: Rare purple faerie flower containing Creo vis; it halts apparent aging and is an addictive drug for magi, banned by the tribunal.

name: Whitlams
description: Inheritable magic items held by redcaps on behalf of House Mercere; also a free virtue for mythic redcaps.

name: Lickstone
description: Whitlam of metal or opal fastened to the palate under illusion, inactive on holy ground.

name: Redcap Warming Pin
description: Enchanted hatpin containing survival magic, passed between redcaps to keep them warm.

name: Pellus
description: The Latin cap of liberty worn as House Mercere's red cap of office.

name: Mercere Triangle
description: Copper triangle badge presented as sigil to each Mercere at gauntlet.

name: Toga Virilis
description: Plain white toga presented to a magus on acceptance into the Order.

name: Toga Praetexta
description: Seamless toga with a purple stripe worn by apprentices and Quaesitores on formal occasions.

name: Bulla
description: Small gold charm inscribed with the master's name worn by apprentices; some are enchanted.

name: Pulla
description: Brown or black toga worn by magi as a sign of mourning.

name: Trabea
description: Purple imperial toga no Alpine magus will wear.

name: Stola
description: Roman women's dress worn by female magi, often with a palla.

name: Hera's Gloves
description: Pale gray leather magical gloves letting Hera handle material objects.

name: Hera's Chatelaine
description: Galena key ring whose keys open every lock in the Cave.

name: Alpenstock
description: Walking stick with an iron spike, used as a quarterstaff.

name: Wizards' Communion
description: Spell hoplites are encouraged to learn.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
description: Spell cast on dead apprentices at Childermas.

name: Gather the Essence of the Beast
description: Spell Viscus feels distorts organs.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: Spell improved via lickstones for redcaps.

name: Mementos
description: Ghost power (ReTe(He) 10) to handle objects emotionally connected to it in life.

name: Unquiet Spirit
description: Ghost power (ReTe 25) for telekinetic flinging of objects.

name: Possession
description: Ghost power Hera never uses.

name: Close Family Ties
description: Virtue suited to chapters drawn from a single Hermetic lineage.

name: Patron
description: Virtue giving support from a powerful figure, such as a leading Alpine magus.

name: Heir
description: Virtue making the character heir to an Alpine chapter house.

name: Public Vis Source
description: +2 variant of Secret Vis Source recorded in the Peripheral Code: 12 pawns and an automatic chair.

name: Secret Vis Source
description: Virtue of which Public Vis Source is a variant.

name: Redcap
description: Free mandatory virtue for mythic redcaps.

name: Indenture (Virtue)
description: Free redcap virtue: lifetime service in exchange for necessities, longevity potion at 35.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Virtue Siobhan learned from a Merinita.

name: Wise One
description: Virtue held by Hera.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue retained by Hera.

name: Destiny
description: Virtue; Hera's destiny is to serve the final Criamon magus.

name: Ghostly Warder
description: Virtue sourced from a magus trained by a ghost.

name: Hermetic Prestige
description: Positive quality for Alpine recruitment.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: Flaw that seriously affects the tone of stories.

name: Discredited Lineage
description: Negative quality for Alpine recruitment.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Flaw alarming to churchmen.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent of magi.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Character type from Hedge Magic that takes the magus slot; redcaps may be built as one.

name: Grog
description: Covenant soldier; shield grogs protect magi.

name: Autocrat
description: Covenant steward.

name: Archmage
description: Senior magus title.

name: Diabolist
description: Infernal practitioner.

name: Hermetic Law
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Enigmatic Wisdom
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: House Criamon Lore
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Athletics
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Greater Alpine Tribunal Lore
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Speak Romansch
description: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical defence; monthly amaranth use grants +3 to Parma Magica.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art; Alpine vis surpluses and deficits of this Art are described.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Magic into which the Cave's regio emerges.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm the Black Mark believes will destroy all magic.

name: Infernal
description: Realm possibly inspiring the Black Mark.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie otherworld where amaranth grows.

name: Alps
description: Mountain range at the spine of Europe.

name: Carinthia
description: Region suitable for Hermetic settlement.

name: Savoy
description: Region suitable for Hermetic settlement.

name: Constance
description: City protected against interference.

name: Passes of Saint Bernard
description: Monasteries vital to redcaps.

name: Ingolstadt
description: Village notorious for amaranth.

name: Bavaria
description: Region where a covenant once fell.

name: Bavarian Common
description: Vis area raided by outsiders.

name: Basel
description: Redcap training site.

name: Geneva
description: City in the Alps.

name: Rhineland
description: Region with autumn covenants.

name: Normandy
description: Receives Imaginem vis.

name: Hibernia
description: Frontier for emigrants.

name: Levant
description: Frontier for emigrants.

name: Iberia
description: Site of border skirmishes.

name: Palestine
description: Site of border skirmishes.

name: Constantinople
description: City sacked by Latins.

name: Library of Alexandria
description: Destroyed by Caesar in parable.

name: Egypt
description: Site of a cat-cemetery.

name: Austria
description: Home of Rauhnachte.

name: North Pole
description: Target of a proposed Hermes Portal.

name: Schism War
description: Historical war before which Criamon requests for observers increased.

name: The Sundering
description: Historical conflict in the Alps with House Tremere, source of ill will.

name: Pralix Incident
description: Event leading to the Order of Miscellany.
